Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.args

Class TaggedArgValue<T>

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.args.TaggedArgValue<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The expected type of the argument's value.
public class TaggedArgValue<T> extends Object
Represents an instance of a parsed tagged argument, holding its name, its value, and its expected type.

This class serves as the data container for a single key-value pair identified by the TaggedArgUtil. An ArrayList of these objects is passed to a command's run method for processing.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

    • copy

      public TaggedArgValue<?> copy(Object val, boolean errorToLabel, SafeJLabel label)
      Creates a new, populated instance of a TaggedArgValue with a parsed value.

      This method validates that the provided value's type matches the expected type for this tag.

      Parameters:
      val - The parsed value object.
      errorToLabel - A boolean to log errors to the SafeJLabel
      label - A SafeJLabel for reporting type mismatch errors.
      Returns:
      A new, populated TaggedArgValue instance, or an error-marked instance if types are incompatible.
